    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The center marker column separates equal-width patterns; retain
    # positions occupied in both patterns and encode them as color 2.
    n = (w - 1) // 2
    left = [row[:n] for row in grid]
    right = [row[n + 1:] for row in grid]
    return [[2 if left[r][c] != 0 and right[r][c] != 0 else 0
             for c in range(n)] for r in range(h)]

}
